title: The Saga of Tanya the Evil
titleEnglish: The Saga of Tanya the Evil
synopsis: What would an ultra-rational Japanese salaryman do if he was reborn as a girl in a world where magic was real? Obviously, become the Empire's most feared magic soldier, while climbing the army career ladder at the ripe old age of nine. The only things standing in Tanya Degurechaff's way are a world war and maybe a supernatural being or two. But Tanya isn't about to let artillery shells or deadly spells stop her when a cushy desk job is calling! (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Anna, the daughter of a baron, was born into a small, rural aristocratic family, but at the request of her kind parents, she ended up attending the country's most prestigious school, the Trusova Magic Academy. At the school, which is a microcosm of the hierarchical structure of the aristocracy, she nearly loses her place, but her fate changes dramatically when she meets the noble and beautiful young lady Rachel. Another story of reversal told from the perspective of Anna, who eventually becomes a saint. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Tsurizao Hitotsu de Isekai Hourou
titleNative: 釣り竿ひとつで異世界放浪
synonyms: Wandering Around Another World with Just One Fishing Rod
synopsis: Owari Machida was a professional fisherman who made a name for himself in the media, but his former glory proved short-lived, and he struggles everyday to make ends meet. One day, while out boat fishing, he gets swept away by the waves and fell into the sea, losing consciousness as he downs because of a malfunction of his life jacket. When Owari awakens, the scenery has completely changed—he finds himself in an Isekai... In this world where the culture of fishing has declined, Owari wanders around enjoying fishing with the fishing gear that transmigrated with him, while interacting with the locals... (Source: Shinchosha, translated)
